summary: Verified the P0 fix for the Counsel Console diff viewer (GET /api/legal/working-drafts/{source_slug} in /app/backend/routers/legal.py L1071-1099). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass — both `content_md` and `released_md` are returned with the leading 'FIRST DRAFT — PENDING COUNSEL RATIFICATION' / 'AI-GENERATED FIRST DRAFT' blockquote stripped, `released_body_hash` equals the hash of the STRIPPED released body (and differs from the raw-body hash), and `is_stale` is false immediately after a draft is created from the current release. Reproduced the exact user scenario: working draft = released body with ONE word changed -> diff is +1/-1 (would previously have been the whole 12-line disclaimer preamble + body). Frontend: logged in as admin@birthright.live, /counsel -> Diff button on 03-cookie-notice; the side-by-side and unified viewers both show '+1 added / -1 removed' and contain NO disclaimer text at the top of either column. Regressions confirmed green: draft creation via POST /api/legal/docs/{slug}/upload, GET /api/legal/working-drafts (list + comment_stats), POST/GET/DELETE working-draft line-anchored comments, GET /api/legal/docs-bundle.zip (valid ZIP, testzip OK), GET /api/legal/pages/cookie-notice. No console errors. Test working draft was discarded at teardown so the preview env is clean.

minor.issue: `_strip_draft_disclaimer` only peels the LEADING blockquote. 21 of the source .md files in /app/backend/legal_docs also carry a mid/footer boilerplate block ('---\n*First draft — pending counsel ratification. Comments to legal@birthright.live.*\n---', e.g. 03-cookie-notice.md lines 49-54) injected by scripts/generate_legal_drafts_v2.py. It is currently identical on both sides so it does not pollute the diff, but if the DOCX-rebuild/release pipeline ever rewrites that block the same class of false-positive hunk returns. Consider stripping it symmetrically too.

issues: Cosmetic: the per-line 'add comment' hover affordance contributes the literal text 'NEW COMMENT' to the diff body's text content in unified mode; harmless but noisy for text-based assertions.
The cookie-consent banner (bottom right) overlaps the diff modal's footer area at 1920x1080; modal buttons remain clickable so it is cosmetic only.

action_items: No blocking action — the P0 diff-disclaimer fix is verified working on both sides of the diff.
OPTIONAL: strip the mid-document 'First draft — pending counsel ratification' boilerplate block symmetrically in _strip_draft_disclaimer (or a sibling helper) to future-proof the diff.
OPTIONAL: /app/backend/routers/legal.py is 2842 lines (>700 guideline) — split into legal/public, legal/working_drafts, legal/comments modules.
critical_code_review_comments: get_working_draft correctly recomputes released_body_hash on the stripped body and compares it to wd['base_released_hash'], which _upsert_working_draft also computes on the stripped release (L991) — hashes are consistent on both write and read paths, so is_stale cannot false-positive from the disclaimer. Verified numerically.
The endpoint returns `**wd` from a projection that excludes _id, so no ObjectId leakage. Confirmed by assertion.

Note the endpoint returns the STRIPPED content_md; any future caller that saves this payload back as the draft body would silently drop the disclaimer from stored content. Today the release/download paths read wd['content_md'] from Mongo directly, so this is safe — but worth a docstring warning.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created an open working draft for slug 03-cookie-notice via POST /api/legal/docs/03-cookie-notice/upload (twice: a divergent body, then released-body-with-one-word-change). Discarded afterwards — GET now returns 404, released .md untouched. One TEST_iter53 working-draft comment created and deleted.
test_credentials: admin@birthright.live / birthright2026 (works). counsel@birthright.live / counsel-review-2026 — counsel returns HTTP 200 (NOT 403) on GET /api/legal/working-drafts/{slug}, i.e. readonly_admin is on the require_roles('admin') allow-list as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_wd_diff_disclaimer.py (module-scoped fixture creates+discards a working draft on 03-cookie-notice; safe to re-run repeatedly). Login response key is `access_token` (fallback `token`). There is NO POST /api/legal/working-drafts endpoint — drafts are created by POST /api/legal/docs/{source_slug}/upload with a multipart `file` field (.md/.docx). There is no 'birthright-hub' legal slug; use 03-cookie-notice or 01-terms-of-service. Frontend testids: counsel-row-{slug}-view-diff, diff-modal, diff-stat-added/removed, diff-mode-side/unified, diff-modal-close.
rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: get_working_draft returned the raw released .md (which the DOCX-rebuild pipeline prefixes with a ~12-line '> **FIRST DRAFT — PENDING COUNSEL RATIFICATION**' blockquote) while the working draft body had that block absent/rewritten, so difflib in DiffModal flagged the entire preamble plus reflowed body as +/- hunks. Fix now runs BOTH sides through _strip_draft_disclaimer(...)[0] and recomputes released_body_hash on the stripped body, aligning it with the base_released_hash written at draft-creation time (L991). Verified: released raw = 79 lines, stripped = 67 lines; a one-word counsel edit now produces exactly +1/-1 in both the API payload and the UI.
